name: Decorator reflection is ordered and permission-filtered without transform handles

input.fixture_ref: Reflect a declaration with argument-bearing decorators from default and privileged package contexts and attempt to mutate the returned transform metadata.

applicability.reason: The current reflection slice exposes ordered identities only, not arguments, phase metadata, generated diffs or policy-filtered views.

expect.status: Reflection preserves identity and argument order, reports package/source and phase participation, filters generated diffs by permission, and exposes no mutable internals or candidate handles.
